name: mem0
description: Give AI apps persistent memory with Mem0: add, search, and manage memories across users, agents, and sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory for AI apps: add, search, and manage memories.
interface.longDescription: Work with Mem0 from Caeros: integrate the memory layer into your apps with the Python and JS SDKs (add and search memories scoped to users, agents, and sessions), run the local-first OpenMemory server for private cross-tool memory, and manage keys for the Mem0 platform. Connects to Mem0's official hosted MCP server (mcp.mem0.ai) exposing the full memory lifecycle as tools.
defaultPrompt: Add Mem0 memory to my chatbot so it remembers user preferences
Design memory scopes for my multi-agent app using user_id, agent_id, and run_id
Set up the local OpenMemory server for private cross-tool memory
